F-128.title: consecutive_progressing_cycles field name misleading

coverage_tick_response_sample.note: All 4 non-overlapping windows show reachable_learned > 0 (2, 3, 10, and at least one more). The value '4' is the count of windows, not a streak count.

evidence.misleading_aspect: Field name implies a streak of consecutive boredom firing cycles where progress was observed. Actual semantics: count of non-overlapping 1h windows in the last 4h that contain at least one new shape learned. With window_design='non_overlapping_rolling_v2' and 4 windows, the maximum value is always 4 regardless of boredom firing count.

evidence.container_git_status: Container has no .git directory in /vessels/ias-executor-ts — git commands return exit 128. Container contains only dist/src/package.json.
evidence.container_reflection: Container was built from the super-repo pointer (49bfb43), not from the local HEAD (b6b58a2). The 3 local commits are NOT running in the container.
evidence.data_loss_risk: If super-repo runs 'git submodule update --init', local workspace repos/ias-executor-ts would be reset to 49bfb43, losing b6b58a2, 37a9ddb, 161eede. These 3 commits exist ONLY in the local filesystem. No container backup, no remote backup.

F-138.assessment: CONFIRMED HIGH RISK. The 3 commits add meaningful substrate functionality (poll-and-wait fragility fix, lifecycle event bus forwarding, dist-drift detection). They are not in the container and not on any remote. A workspace reset or fresh clone would lose them permanently. The super-repo has not been updated to point to b6b58a2, so the divergence is invisible to anyone using the submodule pointer.
